Unit 1 · Letter Pairs bl cl fl
1 Words and Pictures (Track 01)
Listen, repeat, and say.
black, blue, blade, blimp, clock, clam, cliff, clap, flag, flame, flute, flap

A Listen and repeat. (Track 02)
Two sounds (blend) and one sound (digraph).
black, blue, blade, blimp
clock, clam, cliff, clap
flag, flame, flute, flap

B Circle the picture with the matching sound.
1 cl-
2 bl-
3 fl-
4 bl-
5 fl-
6 cl-

C Write the words with the same letter pair sound.
Words: cliff, blimp, flame, blade, clap, flute, blue, flap, clam
black: blimp (example), ___, ___
flag: ___, ___, ___
clock: ___, ___, ___

D Listen. Circle the two words that begin with a letter pair sound. (Track 03)
1 blue, flute, bike (example: blue, flute)
2 flap, cave, cliff
3 fuse, flag, clam
4 fire, blimp, flame
5 cute, clock, black
6 blade, bake, clap

E Listen and match the picture with the right sentence. (Track 04)
Sight words: the, a, with, has
A prince with a flute stands on a cliff.
A blue bike has black wheels.
Look! The fox has a clam.
Two hens flap their wings by the hut.

F Look at the pictures. Write the words in the puzzle.
Eight picture clues, across and down (example: black, 1 down).

G Write the word for each picture. Fill in the circle next to the sentence with the word.
1 The bear claps his hands. / The cat has a clam on its nose. (example: clap)
2 The flute is in the black box. / The flag flaps in the wind.
3 The black bug flies in the sky. / The blimp is up in the sky.
4 The fox cuts the note with the blade. / The blue paint comes out of the tube.
I finished Unit 1!

Audio and Credits
Listen: this book has 47 audio tracks (MP3). The track number in each headphone tag, for example Track 07, matches the file name Book4_Track07.mp3. Find the files in the Audio folder of your download. Play them on any phone, tablet or computer, as often as you like. Press play, listen, pause, then answer. Most tracks are played twice. No audio yet? Teachers can read the scripts aloud from the Teacher's Guide.

Jurassic English Phonics
Book 4 · Letter Pairs
Jurassic English Phonics is a five-book series that helps young learners read and spell English with confidence.
In Book 4, children learn letter pair sounds like bl, cr, sh, th and wh through themed units, songs, games and stories.
8 themed units, 2 review units and a Challenge · Listening tracks, word games and picture stories · A test and key vocabulary list at the back
The series: Book 1, Book 2, Book 3, Book 4, Book 5
by Matthew Goslee · WorldWise Learning · www.jurassicenglish.com
